label: Gmail
description: Create a professional email signature for Gmail in under 2 minutes. Copy with one click and paste directly into Gmail Settings.
installInstructions: Click "Copy for Gmail" in the generator
Open Gmail and click the gear icon (top right)
Click "Create new" and give it a name
Click inside the editor, press Ctrl+A then Ctrl+V

label: Apple Mail
description: Create a professional Apple Mail email signature. Our HTML signatures render correctly across all Apple Mail versions on Mac and iPhone.
installInstructions: Click "Copy for Gmail" in the generator
Click "+" to add a new signature
Uncheck "Always match my default message font"
Click inside the signature editor, press Cmd+A then Cmd+V

label: Google Workspace
description: Create professional email signatures for your entire Google Workspace team. Compatible with all Google Workspace Gmail plans.
installInstructions: Click "Copy for Gmail" in the generator
Open Gmail in your Google Workspace account
Click the gear icon → "See all settings"
Scroll to the "Signature" section and create a new signature
